debut.basis: 540 debut runs 2023-07 to 2026-10 on the runner pages (ATW ratings as given, no results-file rating): rating minus mean formula Proj of the race's runners with 3+ runs (at least 2 of them in the page store, which holds part of each field), on ln(starting price) minus the field's mean ln price (results files give the whole field). Held out from 2026-01-01 (338 runs): RMSE 11.24 with the price vs 12.77 for a constant. Slope -5.0 to -5.5 in every variant (min experienced runners 1, 2, 3); intercept -2.7 to -3.2; sd 11.1 to 11.5 (inflated by the partial-field race level, live may be a little lower).
